title: Quiz: HTML in Modern Frameworks
description: Check your understanding of HTML in Modern Frameworks.

questions.question: Which of these is the correct way to write a comment in HTML?
questions.explanation: In HTML, <!-- --> marks a comment. Block comments use -->.

questions.question: What does JSX compile down to?
options: Function calls that create DOM elements
questions.correctAnswer: Function calls that create DOM elements
questions.explanation: JSX is syntax sugar; the framework builds real DOM nodes.

questions.question: True or False: Frameworks replace the need to understand HTML semantics.
questions.explanation: This statement is incorrect — review the lesson.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: frameworks render ${html} under the hood
questions.explanation: Everything ends up as DOM elements in the browser.

questions.question: In HTML, what is the safest way to predict what a program outputs?
options: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.correctAnswer: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.explanation: Read top to bottom, track variable values, and note every output statement.
